lines.scene: Breathe. The yard is a lung.
Hwarang. Flower and steel
in the same stupid beautiful body.
We spar until the joke gets sharp.

lines.text: Jab-eun deut hahl-tteh, pago-deu-neun keu-rohm-eh bee-neul,
lines.scene: Then we laugh, because the laugh
is how you know you aren't dead.

lines.text: Sanso gateun nuh, nahn nuhman deu-ree-shwee-myun
lines.scene: Oxygen is the friend beside you

lines.text: Dashee nehbeh-teul soo uppsuh, ee jahn-een-han goh-tong sohk-eh
lines.scene: not falling over. That's the lyric.
No, it's this: I need you alive
long enough to annoy me tomorrow.
Class after class. Same bruises.
New boys trying to stand like us.
Let them. We'll correct their feet
and steal their admirers.
The girls on the rail can look.

lines.text: Sanso gateun nuh, nahn nuhman deu-ree-shwee-myun
lines.scene: Looking doesn't swing a sword.

lines.text: Dashee nehbeh-teul soo uppsuh, ee jahn-een-han goh-tong sohk-eh
lines.scene: Every generation does.
Good. Nerve is renewable.

lines.text: Uh-reum gaht-dun sarang, dahl-kohm heht-dun go-tong
lines.scene: Pass the water. Not the speech.
If I go down, you pick me up
without making it tender in public.
Tender later. If you want.

lines.text: Sanso gateun nuh, nahn nuhman deu-ree-shwee-myun
lines.scene: Flower youth.

lines.text: Dashee nehbeh-teul soo uppsuh, ee jahn-een-han goh-tong sohk-eh
lines.scene: Don't wilt for an audience.
Wilt for the bath, the bandage,

lines.text: Jjeett-kyuh-jeen deut-han neh sarang-eh ah-peum, ee dohk-hahn seul-peum kkeh-jyuh buh-reen nah-eh uh-rum sohk-eh heu-reu-neun noon-mool
lines.scene: the person who knows your tell.

lines.text: Naraga buh-reen, kyuhl-kook nahl buh-reen, jee-dohk-han hyang-kee
lines.scene: Then come back breathing hard
like the country depends on it.

lines.text: Gahl-soo-rohk jeechyuh nun sanso gahtah nehgeh
lines.scene: Some days it does.

lines.text: Sanso gateun sanso gateun sanso gateun nuh
lines.scene: In. Out.

lines.text: Sanso gateun sanso gateun sanso gateun nuh
lines.scene: Again.

lines.text: Sanso gateun sanso gateun sanso gateun nuh
lines.scene: We are still here.

lines.text: Sanso gateun sanso gateun sanso gateun nuh
lines.scene: That is the whole hymn.
